gloss: business trip destination; place one is posted to

definitions.gloss: business trip destination; place one is sent to for work
definitions.explanation: The location where someone goes for a business trip. Refers to the destination itself, not the journey.

examples.japanese: {出張先|しゅっちょうさき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a phone call from the business trip location.

examples.japanese: {出張先|しゅっちょうさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}して→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧おいて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please book a hotel at the business trip destination.

examples.japanese: {出張先|しゅっちょうさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせ→打ち合わせ：07155_uchiawase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: I plan to have a meeting with the local business partner at my trip destination.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧ (business trip) + ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination; place). The suffix ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ is productive in Japanese and attaches to many activity nouns to indicate the destination or place associated with that activity.

THE ～{先|さき} PATTERN:
- ⟦{旅行先|りょこうさき}→旅行先：28195_ryokousaki⟧: travel destination
- {転勤先|てんきんさき}: new post (after transfer)
- ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}→引っ越し先：21647_hikkoshisaki⟧: new address (after moving)
- {就職先|しゅうしょくさき}: place of employment
- ⟦{連絡先|れんらくさき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧: contact information

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出張先|しゅっちょうさき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to return from a business trip
- {出張先|しゅっちょうさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a meeting at the destination
- {出張先|しゅっちょうさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧: hotel at the business trip location

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {赴任先|ふにんさき}: place of assignment — implies a longer-term posting, not a short trip
- {出向先|しゅっこうさき}: place of secondment — where one is temporarily transferred to work
